subject: Tests: Add subject alternative names to the TLS test certificates (#4383)
reason: The change modifies only test infrastructure: tests/unit/tls.tcl (the TCL test suite's TLS client setup) and utils/gen-test-certs.sh (the script that generates self-signed test certificates with added subjectAltName extensions). No Valkey server, command, replication, persistence, or tool code changes, so there is no behaviour difference between the builds for a scenario to reach.
